user.title: Set up HA Security
user.description: Read-only authentication observations and user-attributed service-call audit, stored locally with configurable retention.

data.expose_network: Expose IP/client details and retained observations on entities

data_description.retention_days: Local history; default 30 days, maximum 365. Also capped at 10,000 events.
data_description.recent_minutes: Default 15 minutes. Recently observed does not mean currently online.
data_description.expose_network: Off by default. Enabling exposes source metadata to entity readers and Recorder.
data_description.enrich_ip: Off by default. Sends public IPs to ipwho.is over HTTPS and to your DNS resolver for hostname lookup. No usernames or credentials are sent. Locations are approximate.
data_description.track_sessions: Uses internal HA connection lifecycle hooks. Reconnect existing clients after enabling. Tracks WebSocket connections, not password logins or HTTP/cloud activity. Off by default.

error.invalid_interval: Enter a whole number of at least 30 seconds.
error.invalid_settings: Check the polling interval, retention days, and observation window.
